title: Describe Image (MLX) (ML Model, MLX (Apple Silicon), Vision)
cap_description: Generate detailed image descriptions using MLX-based vision-language models on Apple Silicon
documentation:
## Purpose

Generates detailed, instruction-following natural-language descriptions of images using MLX-optimized vision-language models on Apple Silicon. Supports local file paths and HTTP(S) URLs as input. Delivers fast, energy-efficient vision inference on Mac M-series hardware.

## Inputs

- A model spec (MLX HuggingFace repo or local path). Defaults to `Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct-4bit`.
- A PNG image file (local path or HTTP(S) URL).
- A text prompt (default: "Describe this image in detail."). Customize to ask specific questions.
- Max tokens (default 256).

## Outputs

A text description of the image as a plain string.

## Notes

- Requires Apple Silicon (M1 or later).
- Qwen3-VL and similar vision-language models can answer detailed questions, read text in images (OCR), identify objects, and describe scenes.
- This cap accepts HTTP(S) URLs directly in the file path argument, unlike the GGUF and Candle variants which require local paths.
- For cross-platform pipelines, use [Describe Image (GGUF)](https://capdag.com/browse/cap:gguf;in="media:image;png";ml-model;op=describe_image;out="media:image-description;textable";vision).

## ML model
Marker indicating the cap invokes a machine-learning model. Inputs typically
include a model spec or model artifact; the cap is subject to model-resolution
and hardware-pressure policies.

The cap invokes a machine-learning model.

## Backend
The inference framework or runtime that loads and executes a model. Backend choice
determines weight format, hardware acceleration, and runtime characteristics. A media
URN that omits the backend tag is backend-agnostic — it accepts any backend.

MLX is Apple's array framework for machine learning, native to Apple Silicon. Models
are stored as safetensors with MLX-specific config. Exploits the unified memory
architecture of M-series chips for fast, energy-efficient inference. Apple Silicon
only.

## Model task
The inference modality of a model. Model-task narrows what kind of inference cap a
model spec is suitable for: an LLM cannot serve transcription, a transcription model
cannot serve text generation. The task tag is part of the model-spec URN; it is set
by the cap declaring its model-spec input slot, not derived from the model file.

Vision-language model for image captioning, visual question answering, and other
multimodal tasks. Accepts text and images, produces text.
